derivation: apparently from the same as H2123 (זִיז); prominence;
def: Ziza, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
